title: The economy of the game: anchors, knobs and the targets of the pace (content/rules/economy.json, schema v0)
description: What the economy simulator reads. The anchors are what is written down (the price of a car, the profit of an hour of driving at each rung of the ladder), and everything else follows from them. Provisional: Systemy V and VI of the design, to be calibrated.

fx_pln_usd.description: The rate the prices of the portals were turned into dollars with. A parameter, not a constant.

net_per_hour.description: The net profit of an hour of driving at rung k of the ladder: base * growth ^ k.

ladder.description: The rungs of the ladder of cars, from the repaired wreck up.

car_value.description: What a car in good order of this rung is worth, in dollars.

offline_window_h.description: How long a car of this rung drives on one tank, in hours: what a visit of the driver pays for.

new_car_by_tier.description: The price of a new car of tier 1, 2, 3 and so on, in dollars.

set_share.description: The set of parts of a tier costs this share of the price of a new car of the tier.

slot_share.description: The share of the set that each slot takes.

knobs.description: What a regulator turns. A knob of 1 changes nothing.

reward_mult.description: Multiplies the profit of an hour of driving.

resale.description: How much of the value of the old car a driver gets when going up a rung.

upkeep.description: The share of the income that goes on service, repairs and tires.

start_cash.description: Dollars in cash and parts from the rewards of the tutorial.

base.description: The experience to reach level n is base * n ^ exponent.

per_hour.description: The experience of an hour of driving, before the activity of the player.

players.description: The kinds of players that are simulated, by a key of their own.

visits_per_day.description: How many times a day the driver comes back to the game.

max_hours_per_day.description: The most hours of driving in a day, however many tanks there are.

activity.description: Multiplies the income and the experience: tournaments, courses and parts put together on the spot.

fleet.description: How many cars drive at once, at each rung.

targets.description: The day on which each kind of player buys the car of rung 1, 2, 3 and so on, that the pace is meant to have.

tolerance.description: How far from the target a day may be, as a share of it.

slack_days.description: A day is the resolution of the model, so a target of a day or two is allowed this many days either way as well.

max_days.description: How long a player is simulated before it is said to have not got there.

tolerance.description: How far a number of the rules of the game may be from the one the anchors give.
